protocol.arithmetic: 4 contexts * (24 single positions + 10 adjacent pairs + 1 output length) * 2 candidate comparisons = 280 tests. Unrun comparisons remain p=1 in the reserved family.
protocol.statistics: Pearson chi-square without Yates correction, SciPy survival probability; symmetric label-blind pooled categories with expected cells >=5, degenerate tests p=1/uninformative. Holm correction over all 280 reserved tests. Post-end positions use absorbing STOP (-1), never condition on surviving to that position.
protocol.nomination_rule: Freeze all three source/runtime/binary/shader/cohort configurations before any positive-temperature output on these contexts. At most the two reserved candidates, including failed or nonbeneficial outcomes. Independent seed arms and complete 1000-seed ranges required. No repeat-to-pass, source substitution or dropping a context.
protocol.scope: Finite regression screen for gross sampling mistakes, not equivalence, rare-event safety or upstream BF16 quality. Report empirical pooled total variation, Cramers V, informativeness and every rejection. Greedy and independent numerical operator checks are separate.
protocol.provenance: Four original software/fantasy prompts; no generated outputs consulted. The short naming case intentionally checks early EOS as well as two-block coverage in the longer cases.

nomination.scope: Independent-seed functional distribution screen, never throughput evidence. All three source/runtime arms frozen before first positive-temperature output; no source substitution or retry-to-pass.
